verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code-first open-source Python framework, so its core functionality (pipelines, flows, recording, metrics, evals) is driven entirely through code. Its only UI pieces, the prebuilt dev UI and React components, are clients of that code, and the official CLI covers scaffolding, evals and deploying to Pipecat Cloud. However, there is no evidence of a documented Pipecat Cloud management API or of parity with any Cloud dashboard, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: a documented Pipecat Cloud REST/management API, an OpenAPI spec, explicit evidence of UI-to-API parity for Cloud features, and independent corroboration.
